wizard.title: Bindery — Import PDF
wizard.pickFileHint: The file stays in your browser's memory. It is never uploaded to the Foundry server.
wizard.qualityNoText: No text layer detected (likely a scan)
wizard.errorEncrypted: This PDF is password-protected. Bindery does not bypass protections and cannot process this file.
wizard.errorGeneric: Could not read this file as a PDF.
wizard.reviewHint: Build a full preview of everything in this document — images, scenes and journals. Nothing is created until you review and confirm.
wizard.journalBuildErrorGeneric: Could not build a preview from this document. See console for details.
wizard.reviewImportDone: Import complete — check the Scenes and Journal sidebars.
wizard.dropHint: or drop it here — no file selected

review.title: Bindery — Review
review.thumbnailOpenTitle: Click to preview this image and erase parts of it
review.journalGroupHint: Images with destination "Journal" and the same group name are bundled into one journal with multiple pages — leave empty to keep each image as its own journal.
review.journalsOptInHint: Full book text as journals is optional — nothing here is selected by default. Images from the "Images" tab (including the "Journal" destination) do not depend on this selection.
review.selectModeHint: Drag a rectangle over the page to cut it out as a new image, added below like any other.
review.selectModeCropFailed: Couldn't cut that region — try again.
review.resizeFailed: Couldn't resize that image — try again.
review.imageRotateFailed: Couldn't rotate that image — try again.
review.targetHint: Nothing is created until you confirm this screen. Cancel at any point and no documents or files are left behind.
review.importErrorGeneric: Import failed. See console for details.
review.footerHintEmpty: Select at least one thing to import (an image, scene, or journal) to continue
review.footerHintUnassigned: The selected images have no destination yet — set Scene, Journal or Token for them to be able to import
review.journalGroupHintShort: Journal images with the same group name land in a single multi-page journal.

gridPicker.title: Set the scene grid
gridPicker.suggestedHint: Grid auto-detected from the image — adjust if needed.
gridPicker.offsetHint: Offset is for preview only — it isn't applied to the created scene. Fine-tune alignment afterwards with Foundry's own "Configure Grid" tool.

imageErase.title: Image preview and erase
imageErase.hint: "View" only lets you inspect the image. Pick an erase tool to remove unwanted parts (for example text captured with the illustration), then apply the changes. "Undo" reverts only the last step (Ctrl+Z); "Restore original" reverts everything.

tokenPrep.title: Prepare token
tokenPrep.dragHint: Drag the preview to reposition the crop. The slider below adjusts zoom.
tokenPrep.removeBackgroundAborted: Couldn't safely remove this image's background (not enough contrast between background and content) — the token will be saved without background removal.
tokenPrep.clickToAddHint: Turn on and click a background area that didn't disappear (e.g. the pocket under a hat brim that touches the body) — each click adds another fill with the same tolerance. "Undo" removes the last click. Dragging doesn't move the crop while this is on.
tokenPrep.frameCustomHint: A PNG with transparency, the same square shape as the token — it will be composited on top.
tokenPrep.setDefaultHint: Save the current shape, background removal, frame, size, and format as the starting point for every token you prepare next.
tokenPrep.setDefaultSaved: Saved as the default token setup.

settings.openWizardMenuHint: Open the Bindery PDF import wizard.
settings.uploadPathHint: Path (in the world's data storage) where images extracted from PDFs are saved.

legal.notice: This tool processes files you own. It does not contain or distribute any publisher's content. Responsibility for holding the rights to imported material rests with you. Import results are not intended for further distribution.

statblockProfileBuilder.title: Statblock profile builder
statblockProfileBuilder.openMenuHint: Build a profile that teaches Bindery how to find and import statblocks from a PDF.
statblockProfileBuilder.emptyList: No profiles yet — create one to get started.
statblockProfileBuilder.confirmDeleteBody: This deletes the profile. This can't be undone.
statblockProfileBuilder.inheritUnmapped: Inherit unmapped fields from the template actor
statblockProfileBuilder.noPdfYet: Load an exemplar PDF in the Source tab to start mapping fields.
statblockProfileBuilder.noPreviewYet: Load a PDF and assign a source to see a live preview.
statblockProfileBuilder.selectFieldHint: Select an Actor field on the left, or click "Actor name", to map it.
statblockProfileBuilder.importPolicyLabel: If an Actor with the same name already exists
statblockProfileBuilder.importHintRunDetection: Run "Test on the whole PDF" first — the import uses what it finds.
statblockProfileBuilder.importConfirmBody: Create Actors from {count} statblock(s)? Policy for existing Actors: {policy}.

diagnostic.IMAGE_DECODE_EMPTY: objId={objId} ({source}): object resolved to null/undefined — likely a failed decode (e.g. missing wasmUrl for JPX)
diagnostic.UNUSUAL_TEXT_ANGLE: Unusual text angle {angle}° (not a multiple of 90°) — assigned to nearest bucket {bucket}°

diagnostic.GUTTER_FALSE_MERGE_REPAIRED: {count} line(s) falsely merged across columns at the same height, split (column confidence={confidence})

diagnostic.IMAGE_TOO_SMALL_UNDECIDED: Image {width}×{height}px, below {threshold}px — could be too small to be useful, but could also be a genuine small icon/portrait. Check the Images tab.
